channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Katie Zacharia serves five days as White House press secretary
item.description: She described failing the bar exam as somewhat inconsequential, saying she would not need to be a barred attorney while in China.

item.title: Woman pleads guilty in $1.2 billion scheme targeting Wes Edens and others
item.description: Court documents allege she concealed a phone in sanitary pads and describe a LinkedIn message and two other men she allegedly defrauded.

item.title: Executives warn boards avoid retirees amid rapid change, leaving some out
item.description: Leaders from H&S, TwinPoint Collective, Black Women on Boards, and Logitech discuss board recruitment and how women can position themselves.

item.title: American Dream now costs $5.3 million, leaving even college grads $1.2 million short
item.description: Rising housing and child-rearing costs drive the increase, as a record number of renters spend over 30% of income on housing.
